head: TikTok's chat app Whee is climbing the App Store
dek: Whee is TikTok's separate app for chatting, sharing stories and keeping in touch with people you know. It works with your existing TikTok account, so your connections carry over. It was #37 in Social Networking among free apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: The maker is TikTok Pte. Ltd. The app is free with in-app purchases.
means: If you mostly message friends on TikTok, Whee puts those chats in their own app.
todo: Search for Whee in the App Store and sign in with your TikTok account.
